projects.title: The Wisloffs Family Heritage Sign
description: A custom family heritage sign made from solid cherry, with the Wisloffs name and Est. 1997 at its center.

The design brings together the flags of Norway, Italy, Ireland, and Germany. Laser engraving gives the piece its detail, while hand painting and finishing complete the sign. The gallery follows the work from raw cherry through the finished piece.

projects.title: Casa de Kelly
description: The customer provided an AI-generated image as inspiration for a personalized "Casa de Kelly" sign incorporating Irish and Spanish design elements.

Kennedy Laser Works adapted the concept into a design that could actually be fabricated from wood, including layered Celtic knotwork, dimensional lettering, and painted flag elements. The finished sign was constructed, detailed, finished for outdoor use, and installed at the customer's home.

projects.title: Squirtle
projects.type: Custom layered laser-cut and hand-painted wood artwork
description: The project began with supplied character artwork that was used as the visual reference for a custom layered wood build.

Kennedy Laser Works translated the two-dimensional source artwork into a multi-layer wooden design suitable for laser cutting, assembly, and hand painting. The individual components were precisely cut, assembled to create physical depth and dimension, and then painted by hand to recreate the character as a finished dimensional piece.
The gallery follows the complete transformation from the original source artwork through raw wood construction, assembly, painting, detail work, and the completed project.

projects.title: Celtics
projects.type: Custom layered laser-cut and hand-painted wood sign
description: This custom project began with customer-supplied artwork of a Boston Celtics design. Kennedy Laser Works recreated the artwork as a dimensional layered wood piece, adapting the original image for laser cutting, assembly, and hand painting.
Individual wood layers were laser cut and assembled to create depth and dimension. The piece was then carefully hand painted, building the colors and details in stages before final assembly.
The completed sign preserves the character and overall appearance of the customer's reference artwork while transforming it into a unique dimensional wood piece.
